Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

SelectTTRL: Representation-Guided Data Selection for Efficient Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (2610.16104v1) · paper method: Percentile selection is fixed before adaptation without target ground-truth answers, while all target questions remain in the evaluation set.

Permanent record ID: cohort8.claim.selectttrl.all-evaluated

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • The selected subset is defined by floor-based percentile ranks and fixed-identifier tie breaking, not post-hoc selection of only correctly answered targets.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

SelectTTRL: Representation-Guided Data Selection for Efficient Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (2610.16104v1) · paper method: SelectTTRL constructs a frozen correctness-related activation direction from paired correct and incorrect answers in a separate TruthfulQA-derived labeled calibration set.

Permanent record ID: cohort8.claim.selectttrl.calibration

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Target labels are not used for this direction, but external calibration labels are used; the method is not wholly label-free.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

SelectTTRL: Representation-Guided Data Selection for Efficient Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (2610.16104v1) · paper method: In the reported experiment, subset baselines retain the same question fraction and vary the selection rule while keeping the TTRL procedure, budget and hyperparameters fixed.

Permanent record ID: cohort8.claim.selectttrl.controlled-rule

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Non-thinking mode; SelectTTRL selects the 25th–60th percentile interval, i.e. 35% of targets, uses 32 voting/16 update samples, and runs on 4 A800 80 GB GPUs. The candidate asserts the comparison protocol, not a generic speedup.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

SelectTTRL: Representation-Guided Data Selection for Efficient Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (2610.16104v1) · paper method: Initial target responses are scored and ranked, then only a prescribed percentile interval receives standard TTRL multi-response sampling and policy updates.

Permanent record ID: cohort8.claim.selectttrl.subset-budget

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Excluded questions still incur initial-response scoring cost; the method changes selection rather than the underlying TTRL rule.
